# acloud_cloud_providers (Data Source)

List all Cloud Providers

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "acloud_cloud_providers" "all" {}

output "cloud_providers" {
  value = [for p in data.acloud_cloud_providers.all.cloud_providers : p.slug if p.available]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organisation` (String) Slug of the Organisation. Defaults to the `organisation` of the provider.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_providers` (List of Object) Cloud providers available to the Organisation, each with `name`, `slug` and `available` (whether the cloud provider can be used). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_providers))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_providers`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
